title: Concept: Dynamic code evaluation via load (lua) — review required
description: In lua, load turns a string into running code. Evaluation sinks collapse the data/code boundary, so any untrusted bytes in the string become an injection primitive. The lua-specific remedy is data-only handling via a data format parser instead of chunk loading.
applicability: lua codebases that build code or expressions from strings via load; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Code execution in the application process when untrusted input reaches the sink; HIGH severity because evaluation sinks rarely constrain what the injected code can do.
